lines.label: Earl Funk (Mayor)
lines.text: I'd like to call this meeting to order. Welcome here, everyone. And at this time, I would like to give the opening to Councillor Susan Penner.

lines.speaker: Susan Penner
lines.title: Councillor
lines.label: Susan Penner (Councillor)
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Mayor. As I was trying to decide what my opening should be today, the only definitive thing I came up with was a case of writer's block. It's not that I don't have anything to say, but it's hard to fix. Inflation or climate change in a 5-minute opening. So I decided to take a different approach and consult my new best friend ChatGPT, uh, to get some inspiration. I entered the prompt, what is positive about Steinbach, Manitoba, uh, to see what it would say, and it actually was pretty good. So I decided I would just read to you what, uh, ChatGPT said about our community. It says Steinbach, Manitoba, a vibrant community, has several positive developments happening. Here are a few examples. Number 1, economic growth. Steinbach has experienced consistent economic growth in recent years. The city has seen an increase in business, including retail stores, restaurants, and services, contributing to job creation and a thriving local economy. This growth provides opportunities for employment and entrepreneurship within the community. Number 2, infrastructure development. The city has invested in infrastructure development to support its growing population and enhance the quality of life for residents. This includes improvements to roads, parks, recreational facilities, and public spaces. Upgrades to infrastructure not only benefit residents but also attract new businesses and contribute to the overall development of the community. Number 3, community engagement. Steinbach is known for its strong sense of community and active citizen engagement. The city hosts various events, festivals, and cultural activities throughout the year, bringing residents together and fostering a sense of belonging. These community-driven initiatives promote social cohesion, celebrate diversity, and create opportunities for residents to connect and contribute. Number 4, healthcare services. The city has a well-established healthcare system with access to medical facilities, clinics and healthcare professionals. The Bethesda Regional Health Centre, along with other healthcare providers, ensures that residents have access to quality medical services, promoting the well-being and health of the community. And 5, volunteerism and philanthropy. Steinbach residents actively engage in volunteer work and philanthropic initiatives. Numerous organizations and community groups provide support and resources to those in need. Through volunteer efforts and charitable contributions, residents demonstrate their commitment to helping others and creating a stronger community. These positive developments highlight the progress and community spirit present in Steinbach, Manitoba. The active involvement of residents, along with local initiatives and investments, contributes to the overall well-being and vitality of the city. As it turns out, ChatGPT is not wrong, or not at least in this case. Steinbach is all these things and more, and my only regret is that I didn't write it myself.

lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Mayor, and to members of council. Variance application file V-2023-10. Okay. The variance application before council is being applied for by Loewen Henderson Banman Legault LLP with the owner of the property being Summerfeld Mennonite Church of Manitoba. Purpose of the variance application is twofold. Firstly, to permit an overall site area of 5.22 acres where the DR-1 Development Reserve 1 zone requires a minimum site area of 20 acres. And secondly, to permit an overall site width of 264 feet, whereas the DR-1 Development Reserve Zone requires a minimum site width of 600 feet. The property is in process of a boundary realignment with a neighboring property, and this application would be to bring the residual parcel into compliance with the City of Steinbach Zoning Bylaw 2100. Notices pursuant to the Planning Act have been issued. There is no written correspondence on file with respect to the application. As I mentioned, it is arising due to a proposed subdivision and boundary realignment for an abutting property. Comments in the file indicate that there are existing drainage facilities on the site to the rear of the existing parent parcel. And if council is prepared to approve the application, recommendation is that approval be subject to any new evidence that is provided at the hearing. hearing and also subject to updated lot grading plans being required and completed to the satisfaction of the city engineer.

lines.text: Good evening. It's a pleasure to be here today. Thanks for— oh, my name. Michelle Bizzini, Director of Economic Development. Address is D4, 284 Reimer Avenue. Thank you. So I've been in this role for about 6 months. We have an ambitious project. I'm going to share that with you in a little bit. And yeah, having been in this position since January, I'm pleased to report that Steinbach Economic Development Corporation has made significant progress in corporation establishment, defining our area of focus while leveraging Steinbach's competitive advantage. Strengths and opportunities. We are thinking bigger, not in terms of size, but rather ambition, as our status as an economic development agency opens doors to leverage partnerships, funding, including additional expertise and resources to assist companies realize global ambitions while enjoying Steinbach's quality of life. So when we were looking at economic development, economic development is Thank you. As we're clearly defining what it looks like. So in March, approximately, we embarked on this project, which we're going to flow through here very quickly today. It's an asset evaluation project and it ended in May or so. So it highlights some of the action items, some of the implementation plan. We won't have a chance to go through some of that today. Thank you, Amanda, for distributing that. So you'll see that at the end of the deck, and if you have any questions about that, that we can address, but I won't necessarily address some of the key points and some of those action items that have been taking place since January. So in lieu of time, we will slide through this project, and I'll give you a synopsis of where we're headed and how we've come to be where we're at. So ultimately what we did— so what we did is we engaged ROI, so research on investment. So we collected some data. It was global data, market trends, et cetera, et cetera. We also interviewed 22 of our stakeholders, including 8 additional operator interviews. And when we compiled that information, we really wanted to look at that logic stream and analyzed it based on global trends, market research and demand, what Steinbach has to offer, what competitors are doing, what would position Steinbach well into the future, and ultimately what aligns with Steinbach's set of values. In order for economic development to be successful in Steinbach, I mentioned that holistic approach, but it's also going to be a collaboration between us, yourselves at the city, The region and beyond, and understanding what that looks like. We can, as being a welcoming community, and we are better together. The strength is there's a new renewed attitude towards Economic development, and agribusiness is the key ecosystem strength. For example, let's say a biotech company, but it means that So that's all of when we're focusing on agribusiness, that cluster ecosystems can support that. And then reframing our cluster, we've chatted about that already. As we enjoy competitive advantage, attracting investment, workers, creating opportunities for not only the primary sector but the spinoff opportunity of others. So here comes our recommendation. So we're reframing Steinbach's opportunity From agriculture to agribusiness. So our vision of Steinbach Economic Development is to be the center of advanced agribusiness on the Canadian prairies. It is a robust, ambitious vision. It does position Steinbach well into the future. So we're not only looking to the 2025, the end of this pilot project, but we're looking well into the future, 30, 40, 50 years. We mentioned, chatted about the agriculture or the agribusiness ecosystem and then how food processing and manufacturing inputs wholesale trade and distribution. Not only is the demand for food growing, but also demand for food that is sustainable, safe, convenient, and available in multiple forms. Steinbach is already delivering on this and can be expanded. Why one cluster? Why agribusiness? That area of focus we chatted about just earlier, so it can facilitate a clear messaging message who we are targeting, who we are targeting. And then there's also opportunities for other sectors. So we chatted about our recommendation, and this is our winning strategy, is Steinbach is a center of advanced agribusiness on the Canadian prairies. Here's just a list of where we'll play.
